title: Research project setup
description: Stand up a research project with sources, a reading log and a digest cadence.

steps.name: frame
steps.prompt: From the project goal, write RESEARCH.md: the question, what a good answer looks like, 5 to 10 candidate sources with URLs, and a reading log table. Fetch each source once and note whether it is worth reading.

steps.name: schedule
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. Register a chore for this project at 06:30 weekdays in auto mode whose continue step reads RESEARCH.md, fetches up to 5 new sources, and appends findings with citations to DIGEST.md. Print the chore id.
